phone.plugin.title: Phone
phone.plugin.summary: The Ergo app on your phone reads local data: pick contacts into profile suggestions, put the phone calendar into Ergo's calendar, and summarize photo times/places and locations into memory day by day
phone.plugin.purge.contacts: Records of the people picked from contacts
phone.plugin.purge.calendar: Events synced from the phone calendar and its connection status
phone.plugin.keep.files: What's already in personal profiles, and suggestions not yet handled (to delete them, first disconnect in Settings · Data sources and delete what was imported)
phone.contacts.title: Phone · Pick contacts
phone.contacts.summary: In the Ergo app on your phone, pick people from the system contacts (it doesn't read the whole address book or need the contacts permission). Their name, phone, birthday and address become profile suggestions, written only after you confirm each one. Not used for memory
phone.contacts.empty: None of the contacts sent had a name
phone.contacts.disconnectNote: Profile suggestions picked from the phone contacts that you haven't handled yet are dropped and their review cards updated; what's already in your profiles stays, and the phone's contacts are untouched.
phone.calendar.title: Phone · Calendar
phone.calendar.summary: The Ergo app on your phone reads (only reads) the events in the phone calendar, syncing every 30 minutes while the app is open, and shows them in Ergo's calendar (marked as from the phone). Not used for memory
phone.calendar.notLinked: The phone calendar isn't connected: in the Ergo app on your phone, open Settings · Data sources and tap "Connect phone calendar"
phone.calendar.badWindow: The sync range has a badly written time
phone.calendar.badTime: Event {key} has a badly written time
phone.calendar.problem.denied: No permission to read the phone calendar{reason}: tap "Connect phone calendar" in the Ergo app on your phone and allow it again
phone.calendar.problem.revoked: Permission to read the phone calendar was withdrawn{reason}: tap “Sync now” in the Ergo app on your phone and allow it again, or turn the calendar permission back on for Ergo in the phone's settings, to keep syncing
phone.calendar.problem.unavailable: The phone can't read its calendar{reason}
phone.calendar.calendarOff: The Calendar plugin isn't enabled: synced events can't be seen for now
phone.calendar.disconnectNote: After disconnecting, the synced phone events no longer show in Ergo's calendar and the phone's own calendar is untouched; choose “Delete what was imported too” to also remove Ergo's copy of those events.
phone.calendar.lost.unavailable: Couldn't read the phone calendar — nothing synced
phone.plugin.purge.photosLocation: Daily photo and location summaries and connection status, the raw photo times/places and location points, and named frequent places (the phone folder in the data directory)
phone.plugin.keep.materials: Memory materials already made from the photo and location summaries (to delete them, first disconnect with imported data in Settings · Data sources, or delete them in Memory · Materials)
phone.photos.title: Phone · Photo times and places
phone.photos.summary: The Ergo app only reads when and where photos in your album were taken (not the photos themselves); while the app is open it reads the last few days and summarizes each day into one entry (how many photos in which part of the day, places go in the scene) for memory
phone.photos.notLinked: The album isn't connected yet: in the Ergo app on your phone, open Settings · Data sources and tap "Connect album"
phone.photos.badTime: A photo's taken time isn't written correctly
phone.photos.synced: Read the times and places of {total} photos, {added} new
phone.photos.noLocation: (no permission to read photo locations, so none have places)
phone.photos.problem.denied: No permission to read the album{reason}: tap "Connect album" in the Ergo app and allow it again
phone.photos.problem.revoked: Permission to read the album was revoked{reason}: turn on the photos permission for Ergo in the phone's settings to keep reading
phone.photos.problem.unavailable: The phone can't read the album{reason}
phone.location.title: Phone · Location
phone.location.summary: The Ergo app records your location now and then (low-power positioning) and sends the points while the app is open; raw points stay with Ergo and can be cleared by day, and each day is summarized into one entry of where you went and how long you stayed, for memory
phone.location.notLinked: Location recording hasn't started: in the Ergo app on your phone, open Settings · Data sources and tap "Start recording location"
phone.location.badTime: A location point's time isn't written correctly
phone.location.mode.foreground: records while the app is open
phone.location.problem.denied: No location permission{reason}: tap "Start recording location" in the Ergo app and allow it again
phone.location.problem.revoked: Location permission was revoked{reason}: turn on the location permission for Ergo in the phone's settings to keep recording
phone.location.problem.unavailable: The phone can't get a location{reason}
phone.media.badWindow: The time range for reading photos isn't written correctly
phone.media.waiting: ; today is summarized once the day is over
phone.media.lost.unavailable: The phone couldn't read it, nothing sent
phone.places.disconnectNote: Named frequent places ({names}, {total} in total): deleted if you choose to delete imported data too, kept otherwise
phone.places.refused.tooLong: Names can be at most {max} characters
phone.places.refused.badWhere: The coordinates of this place aren't valid
phone.places.refused.badRadius: The range can only be 100, 200, 300, 500 or 1000 m
phone.places.refused.tooMany: You can name at most {max} places; delete some first
phone.places.refused.notFound: That place doesn't exist (it may have been deleted)
